ownerStatement: Approved by repeat98 in chat 21 Oct 2026: "waive and merge", then "waived", for APPLY SCENE 0.1.0-experimental (PR #744), after being told its performance record has no static cycle bound.
reason: The module's cost is dominated by stock's page-1 parameter writer, which took 76 to 1,404,162 instructions per write in one apply, so nothing in this repository bounds it and the contributor could not give a static upper bound. Measured emulator figures are in evidence/performance.json (11,083,553 executed ColdFire instructions for the worst blend, 8,268,075 for verify.py's worst case), against a 100 ms key-press target; they are emulator measurements, not chip cycles or hardware results. The owner waives only the missing static worst-case bound for this exact native source. Hardware results remain as recorded in evidence/hardware.md (one MKII, 15 Oct 2026, functional only); no waiver covers current-build hardware.
